Release Linux/Windows signing builds no longer invoke Rust cache restoration or setup-node npm caching. Cache readers were removed rather than assuming every default-branch/manual-dispatch writer is trusted. This resolves the four configured cache findings; runner/dependency trust remains a separate boundary.

Pinned setup-node commit 49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 is v4: cache is explicitly empty. Its runtime restores only when the cache input is truthy and saves only when the matching action state was set. No package-manager-cache input exists in this pinned version. Two Zizmor locations remain, but these bundled control-flow guards establish that the configured action does not read or save the Actions dependency cache. The scanner result alone does not establish a cache reader. The exception depends on the exact action SHA and empty input and must be reevaluated on upgrade.
